# Zuri schema reference

<!-- Generated by `zuri schema --markdown`. Do not edit: change crates/zuri-core/src/schema.rs and run scripts/verify.sh. -->

Every object in a Zuri document is `{ "type", ...properties, "children": [...] }`. A reference property holds the `name` of its target.

## Artboard

A canvas with its own size, content, animations, state machines and view model. Fill children paint its background. Lives at the top level of the document.

| Property | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  | Name. Other objects refer to this one by it, so referenced names must be unique within an artboard. |
| `width` | number | `0.0` | Width in artboard units. Geometry is centered on its position; an Artboard and a Layout start at 0,0. A Layout with width (or height) 0 is as large as what it holds. |
| `height` | number | `0.0` | Height in artboard units. |
| `clip` | boolean | `true` | Clip content to the artboard bounds. |

## Node

A group: transforms and fades everything inside it. With `solo` it shows one child at a time. Lives inside Artboard, Node, Shape, Bone, Layout.

| Property | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  | Name. Other objects refer to this one by it, so referenced names must be unique within an artboard. |
| `x` | number | `0.0` | Horizontal position in the parent's space, in artboard units. |
| `y` | number | `0.0` | Vertical position in the parent's space (y grows downward). |
| `rotation` | number | `0.0` | Rotation in degrees, clockwise. |
| `scaleX` | number | `1.0` | Horizontal scale. |
| `scaleY` | number | `1.0` | Vertical scale. |
| `opacity` | number | `1.0` | Opacity 0..1. Multiplies down to descendants. |
| `order` | number | `0.0` | Draw order among siblings: higher is drawn later (on top); equal values keep document order. Animatable. |
| `solo` | integer | `0.0` | Draw only this child: 1 is the first drawable child, 2 the second, and so on. 0 draws all. Key it to switch between children. |

## Shape

Geometry children (Rectangle, Ellipse, Polygon, Star, Path) painted by Fill and Stroke children, in order. Lives inside Artboard, Node, Shape, Bone, Layout.

| Property | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  | Name. Other objects refer to this one by it, so referenced names must be unique within an artboard. |
| `x` | number | `0.0` | Horizontal position in the parent's space, in artboard units. |
| `y` | number | `0.0` | Vertical position in the parent's space (y grows downward). |
| `rotation` | number | `0.0` | Rotation in degrees, clockwise. |
| `scaleX` | number | `1.0` | Horizontal scale. |
| `scaleY` | number | `1.0` | Vertical scale. |
| `opacity` | number | `1.0` | Opacity 0..1. Multiplies down to descendants. |
| `order` | number | `0.0` | Draw order among siblings: higher is drawn later (on top); equal values keep document order. Animatable. |
| `blendMode` | `normal` `multiply` `screen` `overlay` `darken` `lighten` `colorDodge` `colorBurn` `hardLight` `softLight` `difference` `exclusion` `hue` `saturation` `color` `luminosity` | `normal` | How the shape's paints combine with what is beneath. |

## Fill

Fills the parent's geometry with a color, or with a gradient / shader child. Lives inside Shape, Artboard, Text, Run, Layout.

| Property | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  | Name. Other objects refer to this one by it, so referenced names must be unique within an artboard. |
| `color` | color |  | Color as #rrggbb or #rrggbbaa. |
| `fillRule` | `nonzero` `evenodd` | `nonzero` | Which regions of a self-overlapping path are inside. |
| `feather` | number | `0.0` | Soft-edge blur radius in artboard units. Use it for glows and shadows. |
| `featherInner` | boolean | `false` | Feather inward from the edge instead of outward: the paint hugs the inside of the outline and fades toward the middle, like an inner shadow or a vignette. |
| `featherX` | number | `0.0` | Shifts the feathered paint horizontally, in the shape's units: a drop shadow's offset, or which edge an inner shadow leans on. |
| `featherY` | number | `0.0` | Shifts the feathered paint vertically. |

## Stroke

Outlines the parent's geometry. Lives inside Shape, Artboard, Text, Run, Layout.

| Property | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  | Name. Other objects refer to this one by it, so referenced names must be unique within an artboard. |
| `color` | color |  | Color as #rrggbb or #rrggbbaa. |
| `thickness` | number | `1.0` | Stroke width in artboard units. |
| `cap` | `butt` `round` `square` | `butt` | Shape of open stroke ends. |
| `join` | `miter` `round` `bevel` | `miter` | Shape of stroke corners. |
| `trimStart` | number | `0.0` | Where the visible stroke starts along the path, 0..1. |
| `trimEnd` | number | `1.0` | Where the visible stroke ends along the path, 0..1. |
| `trimOffset` | number | `0.0` | Shifts the trimmed range along the path; wraps around. |
| `trimMode` | `sequential` `synced` | `sequential` | With several paths in a shape: `sequential` trims them as one long path, one after another; `synced` trims each by the same fraction. |
| `dash` | number | `0.0` | Length of each dash along a stroke. 0 draws a solid line. |
| `gap` | number | `0.0` | Stroke: length of the gap between dashes (0 uses the dash length). Layout: the space between one child and the next. NestedArtboard with a `count`: the space between one copy and the next. |
| `dashOffset` | number | `0.0` | Shifts the dash pattern along the path. Animate it for marching ants. |
| `feather` | number | `0.0` | Soft-edge blur radius in artboard units. Use it for glows and shadows. |
| `featherX` | number | `0.0` | Shifts the feathered paint horizontally, in the shape's units: a drop shadow's offset, or which edge an inner shadow leans on. |
| `featherY` | number | `0.0` | Shifts the feathered paint vertically. |

## LinearGradient

Gradient along a line. Needs GradientStop children. Lives inside Fill, Stroke.

| Property | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  | Name. Other objects refer to this one by it, so referenced names must be unique within an artboard. |
| `x0` | number | `0.0` | Gradient start x (linear) or center x (radial), in the shape's space. |
| `y0` | number | `0.0` | Gradient start y (linear) or center y (radial). |
| `x1` | number | `0.0` | Linear gradient end x. |
| `y1` | number | `0.0` | Linear gradient end y. |

## RadialGradient

Gradient outward from a center. Needs GradientStop children. Lives inside Fill, Stroke.

| Property | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  | Name. Other objects refer to this one by it, so referenced names must be unique within an artboard. |
| `x0` | number | `0.0` | Gradient start x (linear) or center x (radial), in the shape's space. |
| `y0` | number | `0.0` | Gradient start y (linear) or center y (radial). |
| `radius` | number | `0.0` | Corner radius (Rectangle, Layout) or gradient radius (RadialGradient). |

## GradientStop

One color along a gradient. Lives inside LinearGradient, RadialGradient.

| Property | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  | Name. Other objects refer to this one by it, so referenced names must be unique within an artboard. |
| `color` | color |  | Color as #rrggbb or #rrggbbaa. |
| `position` | number | `0.0` | Gradient stop position, 0..1. `followPath` Constraint: where along the target's outline, 0..1 (it wraps, so it can be animated past 1). Text with `follow`: where along the outline the text sits. |

## Clip

Clips its parent (and everything inside it) to the outline of `source`: a Shape, a Text, or the box of an Image or Model. Lives inside Node, Shape, Image, Text, NestedArtboard, Model, Bone, Layout.

| Property | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `source` | reference |  | Clip: the Shape (or Text, Image, Model) whose outline clips. Bind: the view-model Property to read. |

A bitmap from an ImageAsset, centered on its position. Width/height 0 = the image's own size. Lives inside Artboard, Node, Shape, Bone, Layout.

| Property | Kind | Default | Description |

| `name` | string |  | Name. Other objects refer to this one by it, so referenced names must be unique within an artboard. |

| `scaleX` | number | `1.0` | Horizontal scale. |
| `scaleY` | number | `1.0` | Vertical scale. |
| `opacity` | number | `1.0` | Opacity 0..1. Multiplies down to descendants. |

| `width` | number | `0.0` | Width in artboard units. Geometry is centered on its position; an Artboard and a Layout start at 0,0. A Layout with width (or height) 0 is as large as what it holds. |
| `height` | number | `0.0` | Height in artboard units. |
| `asset` | reference |  | The ImageAsset, FontAsset, MeshAsset or ShaderAsset this object uses, or the AudioAsset an Event plays. |
| `sliceLeft` | number | `0.0` | Nine-slice: how many pixels of the picture (of its ImageAsset's `width` x `height`) at the left keep their size when the Image is drawn wider or narrower than the picture. With any slice set, corners keep their size, edges stretch along their length and the middle stretches both ways (a panel or button background). |
| `sliceTop` | number | `0.0` | Nine-slice: image pixels at the top that keep their size. |
| `sliceRight` | number | `0.0` | Nine-slice: image pixels at the right that keep their size. |
| `sliceBottom` | number | `0.0` | Nine-slice: image pixels at the bottom that keep their size. |

## Text

Text set in a FontAsset, painted by its Fill/Stroke children. `width` > 0 wraps lines. Lives inside Artboard, Node, Shape, Bone, Layout.

| `y` | number | `0.0` | Vertical position in the parent's space (y grows downward). |
| `rotation` | number | `0.0` | Rotation in degrees, clockwise. |
| `scaleX` | number | `1.0` | Horizontal scale. |
| `scaleY` | number | `1.0` | Vertical scale. |
| `opacity` | number | `1.0` | Opacity 0..1. Multiplies down to descendants. |
| `order` | number | `0.0` | Draw order among siblings: higher is drawn later (on top); equal values keep document order. Animatable. |
| `text` | string |  | The text to display. Newlines start new lines. |
| `asset` | reference |  | The ImageAsset, FontAsset, MeshAsset or ShaderAsset this object uses, or the AudioAsset an Event plays. |
| `size` | number | `16.0` | Font size in artboard units. |
| `width` | number | `0.0` | Width in artboard units. Geometry is centered on its position; an Artboard and a Layout start at 0,0. A Layout with width (or height) 0 is as large as what it holds. |
| `align` | `left` `center` `right` | `left` | Horizontal text alignment. |
| `lineHeight` | number | `1.2000000476837158` | Line height as a multiple of the font size. |
| `weight` | number | `400.0` | Font weight (100..900) for variable fonts; ignored by static fonts. Animatable. |
| `follow` | reference |  | Text: a Shape whose outline the text is set along, its baseline on the line, each letter turned to it. `position` says where along the outline (0..1) the text starts (or is centered, or ends: `align`), and can be animated. A closed outline wraps; letters past the end of an open one are not drawn. |
| `position` | number | `0.0` | Gradient stop position, 0..1. `followPath` Constraint: where along the target's outline, 0..1 (it wraps, so it can be animated past 1). Text with `follow`: where along the outline the text sits. |

## NestedArtboard

A live instance of another artboard (a reusable component). Bind children with `into` pass it data. With a `count` it is a list: that many copies in a row or a column. Lives inside Artboard, Node, Shape, Bone, Layout.

| Property | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  | Name. Other objects refer to this one by it, so referenced names must be unique within an artboard. |
| `x` | number | `0.0` | Horizontal position in the parent's space, in artboard units. |
| `y` | number | `0.0` | Vertical position in the parent's space (y grows downward). |
| `rotation` | number | `0.0` | Rotation in degrees, clockwise. |
| `scaleX` | number | `1.0` | Horizontal scale. |
| `scaleY` | number | `1.0` | Vertical scale. |
| `opacity` | number | `1.0` | Opacity 0..1. Multiplies down to descendants. |
| `order` | number | `0.0` | Draw order among siblings: higher is drawn later (on top); equal values keep document order. Animatable. |
| `artboard` | reference |  | The Artboard a NestedArtboard instantiates. |
| `play` | string |  | Name of the StateMachine or Animation of the nested artboard to play. Omit to play its first state machine, or failing that its first animation. |
| `count` | number | `1.0` | NestedArtboard: how many copies of the artboard there are, one after the other along `flow` with `gap` between them: a list. Key it, or bind it to a number Property that the host sets. Each copy has a view model of its own, which the host reaches by the copy's position, from 0: `rows/2/title`. A part of one is none (default 1). An instance holds 4096 nested instances in all: a list stops growing there until there is room, and one that does not fit when the file is instantiated is an error. |
| `flow` | `row` `column` | `row` | Layout: whether its children stand side by side (`row`) or one under the other (`column`). NestedArtboard with a `count`: the same for its copies. |
| `gap` | number | `0.0` | Stroke: length of the gap between dashes (0 uses the dash length). Layout: the space between one child and the next. NestedArtboard with a `count`: the space between one copy and the next. |

## Track

Animates one property of one object through its Key children. Lives inside Animation.

| Property | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | reference |  | Track: the object to animate. Listener: the shape or node that receives the pointer (omit for the whole artboard). Constraint: the object to follow. Skin: the Bone that holds the path. |
| `property` | property-name |  | Name of the property to animate or bind. |

## Constraint

Makes its parent follow another object: its position, rotation or scale, a distance from it, or a place along its outline. Applied after animation, in artboard space; several apply in order. Lives inside Node, Shape, Image, Text, NestedArtboard, Model, Bone, Layout.

| Property | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  | Name. Other objects refer to this one by it, so referenced names must be unique within an artboard. |
| `constrain` | `translation` `rotation` `scale` `transform` `distance` `followPath` `ik` | `translation` | What a Constraint takes from its target: its position, rotation, scale or all three; a `distance` to keep from it; a place along its outline (`followPath`); or, on a Bone, `ik`: turn this bone and its parents so that its far end reaches the target. |
| `target` | reference |  | Track: the object to animate. Listener: the shape or node that receives the pointer (omit for the whole artboard). Constraint: the object to follow. Skin: the Bone that holds the path. |
| `strength` | number | `1.0` | How much of the constraint applies, 0..1. Animate it to blend a constraint in and out. |
| `axis` | `both` `x` `y` | `both` | `translation` and `scale` Constraints: the axis to take from the target. The other keeps its own value. |
| `factor` | number | `1.0` | `translation`, `rotation` and `scale` Constraints (not `transform`): what is copied is multiplied by this. 0.5 follows at half the rate, -1 goes the other way. |
| `offset` | boolean | `false` | `translation`, `rotation` and `scale` Constraints (not `transform`): the object's own `x` / `y` or `rotation` is added to what is copied, and its own scale multiplied in, so it sits that far from the target instead of on it. |
| `min` | number | `-1000000000.0` | `translation`, `rotation` and `scale` Constraints: the least that what is copied may be, after `factor` and `offset`: a position in artboard units, a rotation in degrees, or a size (a mirrored target stays mirrored). Bind of a number: the least it writes, after `mul` and `add`. The default is far below anything in a scene, which is no limit. |
| `max` | number | `1000000000.0` | `translation`, `rotation` and `scale` Constraints: the most that what is copied may be, after `factor` and `offset`. Bind of a number: the most it writes. The default is no limit (for a Bind, so is anything a billion or more from 0); if `min` is above `max`, `max` wins. |
| `distance` | number | `0.0` | The distance a `distance` Constraint keeps from its target, in artboard units. |
| `limit` | `closer` `further` `exact` | `closer` | `distance` Constraint: stay no further than `distance` (`closer`), no nearer (`further`), or exactly at it. |
| `position` | number | `0.0` | Gradient stop position, 0..1. `followPath` Constraint: where along the target's outline, 0..1 (it wraps, so it can be animated past 1). Text with `follow`: where along the outline the text sits. |
| `orient` | boolean | `true` | `followPath` Constraint: turn to face along the path. |
| `bones` | integer | `2.0` | `ik` Constraint: how many bones turn to reach the target, counting the bone the Constraint is on and then its parents. |

## Bone

A joint of a skeleton: it carries what is inside it, as a Node does, and a Bone inside it starts at its far end (`length` along its x axis). Chains of bones can be posed by an `ik` Constraint. Lives inside Artboard, Node, Shape, Bone, Layout.

| Property | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  | Name. Other objects refer to this one by it, so referenced names must be unique within an artboard. |
| `x` | number | `0.0` | Horizontal position in the parent's space, in artboard units. |
| `y` | number | `0.0` | Vertical position in the parent's space (y grows downward). |
| `rotation` | number | `0.0` | Rotation in degrees, clockwise. |
| `scaleX` | number | `1.0` | Horizontal scale. |
| `scaleY` | number | `1.0` | Vertical scale. |
| `opacity` | number | `1.0` | Opacity 0..1. Multiplies down to descendants. |
| `order` | number | `0.0` | Draw order among siblings: higher is drawn later (on top); equal values keep document order. Animatable. |
| `length` | number | `0.0` | Length of a Bone, along its x axis. A Bone inside a Bone starts at its parent's far end. |

## Skin

Binds its parent Path to a Bone, so that the outline bends when the bone moves: one Skin per bone, each with `weights`. The path fits its bones in the pose the document's own values describe (before Constraints, animation and Binds). Lives inside Path.

| Property | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | reference |  | Track: the object to animate. Listener: the shape or node that receives the pointer (omit for the whole artboard). Constraint: the object to follow. Skin: the Bone that holds the path. |
| `weights` | string |  | Skin: how firmly the bone holds each point of the Path, from 0 to 1, as numbers separated by spaces: one per point, in the order of the path data. A line (`M`, `L`, `H`, `V`) has one point; every curve has three, its two handles and then its end (`C`; `S`, `Q` and `T` each become one such curve, an arc `A` one per quarter turn). A point goes with its bones in proportion to their weights. Without `weights` the bone holds every point alike. |

## Run

A stretch of a Text in its own style. A Text with Runs shows them one after another as one text (its own `text` is not shown). A Run has its own `size` and `weight`, and its Text's font unless it names an `asset`; with Fill or Stroke children it is painted by those, on top of what the Text's paints paint. Lives inside Text.

| Property | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  | Name. Other objects refer to this one by it, so referenced names must be unique within an artboard. |
| `text` | string |  | The text to display. Newlines start new lines. |
| `asset` | reference |  | The ImageAsset, FontAsset, MeshAsset or ShaderAsset this object uses, or the AudioAsset an Event plays. |
| `size` | number | `16.0` | Font size in artboard units. |
| `weight` | number | `400.0` | Font weight (100..900) for variable fonts; ignored by static fonts. Animatable. |

## Layout

A box that arranges what is inside it in a row or a column, like a CSS flex container: Shapes, Texts, Images, Nodes and other Layouts, each taking the room of its own box. Fill and Stroke children paint the box. Inside a Layout, a child's `x` and `y` move it from the place the Layout gives it. Lives inside Artboard, Node, Layout, Bone.

| Property | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  | Name. Other objects refer to this one by it, so referenced names must be unique within an artboard. |
| `x` | number | `0.0` | Horizontal position in the parent's space, in artboard units. |
| `y` | number | `0.0` | Vertical position in the parent's space (y grows downward). |
| `rotation` | number | `0.0` | Rotation in degrees, clockwise. |
| `scaleX` | number | `1.0` | Horizontal scale. |
| `scaleY` | number | `1.0` | Vertical scale. |
| `opacity` | number | `1.0` | Opacity 0..1. Multiplies down to descendants. |
| `order` | number | `0.0` | Draw order among siblings: higher is drawn later (on top); equal values keep document order. Animatable. |
| `width` | number | `0.0` | Width in artboard units. Geometry is centered on its position; an Artboard and a Layout start at 0,0. A Layout with width (or height) 0 is as large as what it holds. |
| `height` | number | `0.0` | Height in artboard units. |
| `minWidth` | number | `0.0` | Layout: the least it is wide, whatever it holds or is given. |
| `maxWidth` | number | `1000000000.0` | Layout: the most it is wide, whatever it holds or is given (the default is far above anything in a scene, which is no limit). One that wraps and fits its content breaks its lines there. Where it is under `minWidth`, this wins. |
| `minHeight` | number | `0.0` | Layout: the least it is tall. |
| `maxHeight` | number | `1000000000.0` | Layout: the most it is tall (no limit by default). Keyed down to 0 it folds the Layout away. |
| `scroll` | boolean | `false` | Layout: its children show inside its box only, and what does not fit along the flow (across it, in one that wraps) is brought in by scrolling: a drag with the pointer, or `scrolled`. |
| `scrolled` | number | `0.0` | Layout that scrolls: how far its content has gone, in its own units, between 0 and what does not fit. A drag sets it; key it, or bind it (`twoWay` to read where a drag left it). |
| `flow` | `row` `column` | `row` | Layout: whether its children stand side by side (`row`) or one under the other (`column`). NestedArtboard with a `count`: the same for its copies. |
| `gap` | number | `0.0` | Stroke: length of the gap between dashes (0 uses the dash length). Layout: the space between one child and the next. NestedArtboard with a `count`: the space between one copy and the next. |
| `padding` | number | `0.0` | Layout: the space between its edge and its children, on every side. |
| `paddingLeft` | number | `0.0` | Layout: more padding on its left side, added to `padding` (less, with a negative number). |
| `paddingTop` | number | `0.0` | Layout: more padding on its top side, added to `padding` (less, with a negative number). |
| `paddingRight` | number | `0.0` | Layout: more padding on its right side, added to `padding` (less, with a negative number). |
| `paddingBottom` | number | `0.0` | Layout: more padding on its bottom side, added to `padding` (less, with a negative number). |
| `wrap` | boolean | `false` | Layout: a child that does not fit along the flow starts a further line (a row below, or a column to the right), `gap` away; each line is as large across as its largest child. `justify`, `alignItems` and `grow` then work line by line. The room is its size along the flow: its own, one given by `grow` or `stretch`, or for one that fits its content its `maxWidth` (`maxHeight` in a column). |
| `justify` | `start` `center` `end` `spaceBetween` | `start` | Layout: where the children go along the flow when there is room to spare: at the start, in the middle, at the end, or spread out with the room between them. |
| `alignItems` | `start` `center` `end` `stretch` | `start` | Layout: where each child goes across the flow: at the start (the top of a row), in the middle, at the end; `stretch` also makes child Layouts as large as the room. |
| `grow` | number | `0.0` | A Layout inside a Layout: its share of the room left over along the parent's flow (0 keeps its own size). Two children with `grow` 1 and 2 take a third and two thirds of it. |
| `radius` | number | `0.0` | Corner radius (Rectangle, Layout) or gradient radius (RadialGradient). |

## Joystick

A handle that poses the scene: `handleX` and `handleY`, each from -1 to 1, say how far into `xAnimation` and `yAnimation` the scene is (-1 is the animation's first frame, 0 its middle, 1 its last). Key them, or bind them to the view model. What the joystick poses is applied after the state machine or animation that is playing; an animation that is itself being played is left to play. Lives inside Artboard.

| Property | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  | Name. Other objects refer to this one by it, so referenced names must be unique within an artboard. |
| `handleX` | number | `0.0` | Joystick: where its handle is across, from -1 to 1. |
| `handleY` | number | `0.0` | Joystick: where its handle is up and down, from -1 to 1. |
| `xAnimation` | reference |  | Joystick: the Animation its `handleX` scrubs through. |
| `yAnimation` | reference |  | Joystick: the Animation its `handleY` scrubs through. |
| `invertX` | boolean | `false` | Joystick: `handleX` runs the other way: 1 is `xAnimation`'s first frame and -1 its last. |
| `invertY` | boolean | `false` | Joystick: `handleY` runs the other way: 1 is `yAnimation`'s first frame and -1 its last. |

## Cue

Reports the `emit` Event to the host each time playback passes `frame`. Lives inside Animation.

| Property | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `frame` | number | `0.0` | Frame this Key or Cue sits on. |
| `emit` | reference |  | An Event to report to the host when this Transition or Listener fires, or this Cue is passed. |

## Key

A key frame. Lives inside Track.

| Property | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `frame` | number | `0.0` | Frame this Key or Cue sits on. |
| `value` | number | `0.0` | Number value. In JSON, `value` may also be a #color or a string; the compiler files it under colorValue or textValue. |
| `colorValue` | color |  | Color value of a Key or Property. |
| `textValue` | string |  | String value of a Key or Property (also path data for `d` tracks). |
| `interp` | `linear` `hold` `cubic` `elastic` `elasticIn` `elasticInOut` | `linear` | How the value moves from this key to the next: at a constant rate, not at all until the next key (`hold`), along a `cubic` curve, or swinging past the next key's value like a spring, on arriving (`elastic`), on leaving (`elasticIn`) or both (`elasticInOut`). On a Transition: how the cross-fade progresses (`linear`, `hold`, which switches at the end, or `cubic`). |
| `easeX1` | number | `0.41999998688697815` | Cubic easing control point 1 x (as in CSS cubic-bezier). |
| `easeY1` | number | `0.0` | Cubic easing control point 1 y. |
| `easeX2` | number | `0.5799999833106995` | Cubic easing control point 2 x. |
| `easeY2` | number | `1.0` | Cubic easing control point 2 y. |
| `amplitude` | number | `1.0` | Elastic Key: how far the value swings past the next key's, 1 or more. |
| `period` | number | `0.5` | Elastic Key: how long one swing takes, as a part of the way to the next key (at least 0.05). |

## StateMachine

Interactive logic: Layers of States joined by Transitions, plus pointer Listeners. Lives inside Artboard.

| Property | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  | Name. Other objects refer to this one by it, so referenced names must be unique within an artboard. |

## Layer

An independent state graph. Layers run together; later layers override earlier ones. Needs one `entry` State. Lives inside StateMachine.

| Property | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  | Name. Other objects refer to this one by it, so referenced names must be unique within an artboard. |

## State

A node of the state graph. Lives inside Layer.

| Property | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  | Name. Other objects refer to this one by it, so referenced names must be unique within an artboard. |
| `kind` | `animation` `entry` `any` `exit` `blend` `direct` | `animation` | What a state does. `blend` mixes its BlendAnimation children along `input`; `direct` lays each of them over the design values, at its own weight. |
| `animation` | reference |  | The Animation a State or BlendAnimation plays. |
| `speed` | number | `1.0` | Playback speed multiplier. |
| `input` | reference |  | The view-model Property a Condition tests, a Listener or Action changes, or a blend State is driven by. On a BlendAnimation of a `direct` State: the number (0..1) that is its weight. |

## BlendAnimation

One animation of a `blend` State, placed at `value` on the input's axis; or of a `direct` State, where `value` (or `input`) is its weight. Lives inside State.

| Property | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `animation` | reference |  | The Animation a State or BlendAnimation plays. |
| `value` | number | `0.0` | Number value. In JSON, `value` may also be a #color or a string; the compiler files it under colorValue or textValue. |
| `input` | reference |  | The view-model Property a Condition tests, a Listener or Action changes, or a blend State is driven by. On a BlendAnimation of a `direct` State: the number (0..1) that is its weight. |

## Transition

Leaves the parent State for `to` when all its Condition children hold. Action children run when it fires. Lives inside State.

| Property | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `to` | reference |  | The State a Transition leads to. |
| `blend` | number | `0.0` | Seconds over which a Transition cross-fades from the old state to the new one. |
| `exitTime` | number | `0.0` | Fraction of the source animation (0..1) that must have played before the Transition may fire. 0 disables the wait. |
| `emit` | reference |  | An Event to report to the host when this Transition or Listener fires, or this Cue is passed. |
| `interp` | `linear` `hold` `cubic` `elastic` `elasticIn` `elasticInOut` | `linear` | How the value moves from this key to the next: at a constant rate, not at all until the next key (`hold`), along a `cubic` curve, or swinging past the next key's value like a spring, on arriving (`elastic`), on leaving (`elasticIn`) or both (`elasticInOut`). On a Transition: how the cross-fade progresses (`linear`, `hold`, which switches at the end, or `cubic`). |
| `easeX1` | number | `0.41999998688697815` | Cubic easing control point 1 x (as in CSS cubic-bezier). |
| `easeY1` | number | `0.0` | Cubic easing control point 1 y. |
| `easeX2` | number | `0.5799999833106995` | Cubic easing control point 2 x. |
| `easeY2` | number | `1.0` | Cubic easing control point 2 y. |
| `pause` | boolean | `false` | Freeze the state being left for the length of the cross-fade. By default it keeps playing underneath. |
| `chance` | number | `0.0` | Random choice: when the first Transition that could fire has a `chance`, one of those that could fire and have a `chance` is picked at random, in proportion. 0 = no randomness. |

## Condition

A test on a view-model Property. Lives inside Transition.

| Property | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `input` | reference |  | The view-model Property a Condition tests, a Listener or Action changes, or a blend State is driven by. On a BlendAnimation of a `direct` State: the number (0..1) that is its weight. |
| `op` | `eq` `ne` `lt` `le` `gt` `ge` | `eq` | Comparison a Condition applies between its input and `value`. Ignored for triggers. |
| `value` | number | `0.0` | Number value. In JSON, `value` may also be a #color or a string; the compiler files it under colorValue or textValue. |
| `with` | reference |  | Condition: compare `input` against this view-model Property instead of against `value`. Listener with event `change`: the Property to watch. |

## Action

Changes a view-model Property when the Transition or Listener it is in fires. Lives inside Transition, Listener.

| Property | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `input` | reference |  | The view-model Property a Condition tests, a Listener or Action changes, or a blend State is driven by. On a BlendAnimation of a `direct` State: the number (0..1) that is its weight. |
| `action` | `set` `toggle` `fire` `add` | `set` | What a Listener or Action does to its input: set it to `value`, toggle a bool, fire a trigger, or add `value`. |
| `value` | number | `0.0` | Number value. In JSON, `value` may also be a #color or a string; the compiler files it under colorValue or textValue. |

## Listener

Turns a pointer event on `target`, a key, or a change of a view-model Property, into changes of view-model Properties and an Event for the host. Lives inside StateMachine.

| Property | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  | Name. Other objects refer to this one by it, so referenced names must be unique within an artboard. |
| `target` | reference |  | Track: the object to animate. Listener: the shape or node that receives the pointer (omit for the whole artboard). Constraint: the object to follow. Skin: the Bone that holds the path. |
| `event` | `enter` `exit` `down` `up` `click` `move` `change` `keyDown` `keyUp` | `enter` | What a Listener reacts to: a pointer event on its `target`; `change`: the Property named by `with` got a new value (or, for a trigger, fired); `keyDown` / `keyUp`: the host reported a key (see `key`). |
| `input` | reference |  | The view-model Property a Condition tests, a Listener or Action changes, or a blend State is driven by. On a BlendAnimation of a `direct` State: the number (0..1) that is its weight. |
| `action` | `set` `toggle` `fire` `add` | `set` | What a Listener or Action does to its input: set it to `value`, toggle a bool, fire a trigger, or add `value`. |
| `value` | number | `0.0` | Number value. In JSON, `value` may also be a #color or a string; the compiler files it under colorValue or textValue. |
| `emit` | reference |  | An Event to report to the host when this Transition or Listener fires, or this Cue is passed. |
| `with` | reference |  | Condition: compare `input` against this view-model Property instead of against `value`. Listener with event `change`: the Property to watch. |
| `key` | string |  | Listener with event `keyDown` or `keyUp`: the key to react to, named as the web's KeyboardEvent.key names it ("Enter", "ArrowLeft", " ", "a"). Omit to react to any key. |

## Event

A named signal reported to the host application. With an `asset` (an AudioAsset) the host also plays that sound each time the event is reported. Lives inside Artboard.

| Property | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  | Name. Other objects refer to this one by it, so referenced names must be unique within an artboard. |
| `asset` | reference |  | The ImageAsset, FontAsset, MeshAsset or ShaderAsset this object uses, or the AudioAsset an Event plays. |
| `volume` | number | `1.0` | Event with a sound: how loud the host plays it, 0..1. |

## ViewModel

The artboard's data contract with the host: a set of typed Properties. Lives inside Artboard.

| Property | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  | Name. Other objects refer to this one by it, so referenced names must be unique within an artboard. |

## Property

A typed value the host, listeners and state machines read and write. Lives inside ViewModel.

| Property | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  | Name. Other objects refer to this one by it, so referenced names must be unique within an artboard. |
| `valueType` | `number` `bool` `trigger` `color` `string` `enum` | `number` | Type of a view-model Property. An `enum` holds one of its Option children: `value` is the Option's position, counting from 0. |
| `value` | number | `0.0` | Number value. In JSON, `value` may also be a #color or a string; the compiler files it under colorValue or textValue. |
| `colorValue` | color |  | Color value of a Key or Property. |
| `textValue` | string |  | String value of a Key or Property (also path data for `d` tracks). |

## Option

One of the values an `enum` Property can take, by name. Lives inside Property.

| Property | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  | Name. Other objects refer to this one by it, so referenced names must be unique within an artboard. |

## Bind

Writes a view-model Property into `property` of the parent object every frame (or `into` a nested artboard's Property). Lives inside Node, Shape, Rectangle, Ellipse, Polygon, Star, Path, Fill, Stroke, LinearGradient, RadialGradient, GradientStop, Image, Text, NestedArtboard, Model, ShaderPaint, Constraint, Bone, Run, Layout, Joystick.

| Property | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `source` | reference |  | Clip: the Shape (or Text, Image, Model) whose outline clips. Bind: the view-model Property to read. |
| `property` | property-name |  | Name of the property to animate or bind. |
| `mul` | number | `1.0` | Bind: multiply the source number by this before writing it. |
| `add` | number | `0.0` | Bind: add this after multiplying. |
| `min` | number | `-1000000000.0` | `translation`, `rotation` and `scale` Constraints: the least that what is copied may be, after `factor` and `offset`: a position in artboard units, a rotation in degrees, or a size (a mirrored target stays mirrored). Bind of a number: the least it writes, after `mul` and `add`. The default is far below anything in a scene, which is no limit. |
| `max` | number | `1000000000.0` | `translation`, `rotation` and `scale` Constraints: the most that what is copied may be, after `factor` and `offset`. Bind of a number: the most it writes. The default is no limit (for a Bind, so is anything a billion or more from 0); if `min` is above `max`, `max` wins. |
| `round` | `none` `nearest` `down` `up` | `none` | Bind of a number: make it a whole number after `mul`, `add` and the limits: the `nearest` one (a half goes away from 0), the next `down` or the next `up`. |
| `into` | string |  | Bind inside a NestedArtboard: name of the nested artboard's view-model Property (of the same type) to write the source into, every frame. Triggers fire through. |
| `index` | boolean | `false` | Bind with `into`, inside a NestedArtboard: write the copy's position in the list, from 0, into that Property (a number), in place of a `source`. With it a file gives the copies of a list different content. |
| `direction` | `toTarget` `toSource` `twoWay` | `toTarget` | Which way a Bind copies: the view-model Property into the object's property (`toTarget`), the object's property into the Property (`toSource`, to read or test an animated value), or whichever of the two changed (`twoWay`; the Property wins a tie). Only `toTarget` applies `mul`, `add`, `min`, `max`, `round` and `format`: the others hand the value on as it is. |
| `format` | string |  | Bind of a Property onto a string property: the text to write, with `{}` standing for the value. A number is written with `decimals` digits after the point. |
| `decimals` | integer | `0.0` | Bind of a number onto a string property: digits after the decimal point. |

## ImageAsset

An encoded image (PNG, JPEG, WebP). The host decodes it. Lives at the top level of the document.

| Property | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  | Name. Other objects refer to this one by it, so referenced names must be unique within an artboard. |
| `width` | number | `0.0` | Width in artboard units. Geometry is centered on its position; an Artboard and a Layout start at 0,0. A Layout with width (or height) 0 is as large as what it holds. |
| `height` | number | `0.0` | Height in artboard units. |
| `bytes` | bytes |  | Asset payload. In JSON: base64, or "@relative/path" to embed a file at build time. |

## FontAsset

A TTF or OTF font. `glyphs` keeps the file small. Lives at the top level of the document.

| Property | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  | Name. Other objects refer to this one by it, so referenced names must be unique within an artboard. |
| `bytes` | bytes |  | Asset payload. In JSON: base64, or "@relative/path" to embed a file at build time. |
| `glyphs` | string |  | Subset the font when `zuri build` or the editor's export writes the file: keep the glyphs for the characters the document's texts in this font can show, plus the characters listed here ("" keeps only the document's). Without `glyphs` the whole font is embedded. Text set at run time can only show characters that were kept. |

## MeshAsset

A 3D mesh in Zuri's packed format. Produced by `zuri import`. Lives at the top level of the document.

| Property | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  | Name. Other objects refer to this one by it, so referenced names must be unique within an artboard. |
| `bytes` | bytes |  | Asset payload. In JSON: base64, or "@relative/path" to embed a file at build time. |

## AudioAsset

An encoded sound (WAV, MP3, OGG...). The host decodes and plays it when an Event that names it is reported; the runtime itself makes no sound. Lives at the top level of the document.

| Property | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  | Name. Other objects refer to this one by it, so referenced names must be unique within an artboard. |
| `bytes` | bytes |  | Asset payload. In JSON: base64, or "@relative/path" to embed a file at build time. |

## ShaderAsset

A fragment shader. Lives at the top level of the document.

| Property | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  | Name. Other objects refer to this one by it, so referenced names must be unique within an artboard. |
| `wgsl` | string |  | Shader source in WGSL. `zuri build` validates it and fills in `glsl` and `hlsl`. |
| `glsl` | string |  | GLSL ES 3.00 translation of `wgsl`, generated at build time. |
| `hlsl` | string |  | HLSL translation of `wgsl`, generated at build time. |
